lines.6: 「You went to middle school together, I hear.」
lines.7: 「As your big sister, I'd love to hear about the trouble you got into back then.」
lines.9: 「Why do you and Konoe get along so badly?」
lines.10: 「Maybe she just finds me instinctively gross or something.」
lines.11: 「That looked like hatred well beyond that.」
lines.13: 「Hahaha. Well, nothing can be done about that.」
lines.15: 「--Did you really think I'd say that? A little brother has no right to remain silent when his sister asks a question.」
lines.22: 「I want to know why you and Konoe are fighting.」
lines.23: 「Ever since she entered Ryuumeikan, she's been a sweet junior who looks up to me whenever she can.」
lines.24: 「As the dependable senior here, I'm trying to settle things between her and my little brother. So tell me.」
lines.25: 「Of course, if you won't talk, I can always use a chain of wrestling holds until you do.」
lines.27: I'd escape by making up a huge lie about computers, an area Otome could never interfere with.
lines.28: 「...The truth is, Konoe and I had a huge fight in middle school over whether Weedows or Maggi was better.」
lines.34: Good. Time to pelt her with a barrage of computer jargon.
lines.35: 「And then we argued about CPUs and video cards, whether DVD-RW was best, what to do about dual-layer discs, USB, and all kinds of other things--」
lines.38: 「So yeah, it's a deep and complicated matter. It can't be solved easily.」
lines.40: That should make Otome give up.
lines.41: This was what you called a kind lie.
lines.44: Being called back made me flinch.
lines.47: 「I wanted to help you, but I'm completely hopeless with computers.」
lines.48: 「Sorry... Your big sister hasn't studied enough.」
